meta.triageRationale: feature tier (standalone LLD -> plan -> build): one cohesive cross-module story; no new subsystem.

summary.prose: Approval is bound to the exact version the human saw. workflow.present verifies the client displayed contentVersion and stores a fresh single-use presentationToken plus presentedContentVersion on the artifact; every approval request (workflow.approve, workflow.reviewDecision, TUI, AMD approveAmendment) carries that token, and under a per-artifact cross-worker lock the daemon requires stored token === request token, unconsumed, within a coarse TTL, and the freshly reread artifact still rendering to presentedContentVersion — then consumes the token. Re-presentation invalidates older tokens, so a stale view can never be approved and no wall-clock ordering is needed. All approval-relevant writers — including questions.ts and resolve-comment.ts — serialize under the same lock with fresh rereads. epicHash batches require explicit artifactIds; overrides are token-gated; bookkeeping fields stay out of the BUILD fingerprint; stale-review remains non-overridable; AMD keeps approvedBy and its terminal reject; document-less records get a contentVersion via deliveryEvidence; MCP keeps its { presented, notPending } contract.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

boundary.internal: Enforce approval hard gates in the daemon: present-before-approve binding, per-artifact attestation, batch limits

parameters.name: jsonPath
parameters.purpose: Artifact being approved; fresh reread by the caller inside the lock.

parameters.name: req
parameters.purpose: Token from the approval request; requirePresent from config (default true).

errors.condition: Absent / wrong / superseded / consumed / TTL-expired token or version drift — all fail closed.

REQUIREMENT: bookkeeping fields never invalidate a BUILD fingerprint; material changes still do. Tests: exclusions; review→present→approve regression; source change → stale-review.

REQUIREMENT: approver bound to displayed version (A/B scenario, equal-ms race fail closed); AMD gated with approvedBy + terminal reject; non-AMD rejection recovers. Tests: A/B integration; AMD unit; reject→re-present→approve.
